about: Listing-site reader configuration that lived in code until commit 3ea6cce4 (2026-11-03) and was not carried into listing_site by migration 20261103_0053. Input for apps/api/scripts/ops/restore_listing_site_readers.py. The script fills only columns that are empty on the site row today; a steward's value is never replaced. Review every value before --apply.

provenance.takealot.adapter_key: registry.record_observation sent this marketplace to takealot_fetch.fetch_takealot_listing (REST product-details + buy box). Its data-driven successor is the rest_buybox_json reader.
provenance.takealot.details_url_pattern: takealot_fetch.product_details_url: f"{TAKEALOT_API_ORIGIN}/rest/{TAKEALOT_REST_VERSION}/product-details/PLID{digits}?platform=desktop" with TAKEALOT_API_ORIGIN = https://api.takealot.com and TAKEALOT_REST_VERSION = v-1-16-0. {page_id} is the digits only, so the site's page_id_pattern must capture the digits after PLID (the dry run prints a sample details URL from a stored listing to check this).
provenance.takealot.page_id_pattern: takealot_fetch._PLID_IN_URL_RE = (?:PLID|plid)(\d{5,12}), used by extract_plid on the stored URL.
provenance.takealot.first_party_seller: quality.EXPECTED_SELLER (the buy-box seller the quality check expected for this marketplace).
provenance.amazon.adapter_key: registry.record_observation fetched the stored URL and ran the generic parse_snapshot_text for every marketplace except takealot. Its successor is the html_page reader (no required columns).
provenance.evetech.adapter_key: As amazon (generic stored-URL fetch + parse_snapshot_text). On cip it already has html_page since autoconfigure 2026-11-12, so the script keeps it.

not_in_code_warren_must_supply: Each reporting customer's own seller names / seller ids per site (listing_site_seller). Code never held them; enter them on Sites & sellers or in the customer's listing_seed.
amazon.page_id_pattern: code only had an ASIN check on the report token (^B0[A-Z0-9]{8}$), not a URL pattern. Not needed by html_page.

amazon.first_party_seller: code never named one (quality.EXPECTED_SELLER had no entry). Leave empty unless the page-shown own-stock seller is known; on a marketplace with third-party sellers a wrong value would mark other sellers' offers as the store's own.
Product links for the amazon listings that have no product_id (see LISTING_CAPTURE_CHECK_20261113 Q2).
